title: Role Weaver — Persistent Character Memory & RP Assistant for NWN
author: RoleWeaver
selftext:
**Role Weaver — Persistent Character Memory & RP Assistant for NWN:EE**

I've been developing **Role Weaver**, a free tool that gives NWN characters something the game has never really had: persistent memory, relationships, knowledge and personality.

Role Weaver reads the NWN conversation log and automatically turns interactions into useful character memories. It tracks relationships and past events, remembers what your character has learned, and lets you control what they *shouldn't* know.

It also maintains distinct personalities and speaking styles, so characters with very different backgrounds and voices remain consistent over long periods of play.

An LLM is used to interpret all of this and suggest contextually appropriate dialogue, but **the LLM is really just the engine underneath the system**. The player still chooses, edits or discards anything it generates.

For DMs, I think there's an interesting possibility as well: persistent NPCs that remember previous player interactions and maintain the same history and personality even when different DMs portray them.

It supports **Gemini, OpenAI and completely local models through LM Studio**.

I'm looking for NWN players and DMs interested in testing it and giving feedback.
